jobs_results.title: UI/UX Design & Frontend Development Intern (Fresher)
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic, creative, and detail-oriented Fresher UI/UX Developer to join our growing team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between interface design and practical front-end implementation. You will work on creating intuitive user experiences, translating wireframes into functional web interfaces, and collaborating closely with our product and development teams.

This position begins with a 3-month unpaid training and evaluation period, structured as an intensive hands-on internship. Upon successful completion and performance review, top performers will transition into a salaried, full-time position.

Key Responsibilities

UI/UX Design: Create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and interactive prototypes using tools like Figma or Adobe XD.Frontend Implementation: Translate design mockups into responsive, clean, and reusable web pages using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.User-Centric Design: Understand user requirements, gather feedback, and continuously refine user journeys for digital products.Cross-Browser & Device Compatibility: Ensure designs render smoothly and consistently across desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.Collaboration: Coordinate with backend developers and project stakeholders to implement UI features and optimize application usability.Qualifications & Requirements

Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Design, Information Technology, or a related field (Recent graduates or final-year students welcome).Foundational Design Knowledge: Familiarity with modern UI/UX principles, design systems, typography, and color theory.Design Tools: Practical knowledge of Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.Frontend Basics: Hands-on understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+). Familiarity with frameworks (React, Tailwind CSS, or Bootstrap) is a plus.Portfolio/Projects: A portfolio, GitHub profile, or sample project links showcasing web design and basic coding projects is required.Mindset: Eager to learn, proactive, receptive to feedback, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment.Compensation & Progression

First 3 Months: Unpaid training and assessment internship.Month 4 Onward: Full-time employment with a formal offer letter and industry-standard salary, subject to performance evaluation during the initial 3-month phase.Perks: Mentorship from experienced professionals, live production project exposure, and an Internship Completion Certificate.Compensation: From 5,000.00 per month

Benefits:

Internet reimbursementWork Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana .

Job Summary   
We are looking for an experienced React / Next.js Developer to join our digital team and take ownership of developing and maintaining our corporate website and related web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong front-end expertise combined with experience in deployment pipelines, CMS integration (Contentful), and contemporary development practices to deliver a seamless and high-performing user experience.  

Must Have Skills (Mandatory)  
Strong proficiency in React.js, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS  
Experience in developing responsive, SEO-friendly, and accessible web pages aligned with brand and UX guidelines  
Proven experience in integrating and managing headless CMS platforms, preferably Contentful  
Hands-on experience with API integration, authentication mechanisms, and web security best practices  
Experience in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools  
Familiarity with version control systems (Git), Docker, and cloud deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Vercel  
Ability to collaborate effectively with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and product managers to deliver functional, scalable solutions  

Good to Have Skills (Optional)  
Experience with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Styled Components  
Knowledge of Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) in Next.js  
Familiarity with analytics and SEO optimization tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and similar platforms  
Experience working with design tools like Figma and integrating design systems  
Robust debugging, performance optimization, and problem-solving abilities  

Qualifications & Experience  
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field  
3 to 6 years of experience in front-end web development using React.js and Next.js  
Demonstrated experience in building and deploying corporate or marketing websites with headless CMS integrations  
Robust understanding of modern DevOps workflows, CI/CD best practices, and cloud-based deployment environments  
Passion for delivering clean, maintainable, and user-focused digital experiences .

Salesforce Commerce Cloud Front-End Developer (UI/UX Implementation)  

Job Summary:   
This position focuses on building a high-quality storefront experience on Salesforce Commerce Cloud using LWR and LWC. The role requires solid proficiency in UI engineering, an eye for design accuracy, and the ability to translate Figma specifications into performant, maintainable front-end components.   

Responsibilities:  
Build and extend storefront pages using LWR and LWC aligned with Salesforce Commerce Cloudarchitecture and guardrails  
Convert Figma designs into responsive, visually consistent, and reusable components  
Implement mobile-first layouts with attention to spacing, grids, typography, and stateinteractions  
Apply WCAG-oriented accessibility standards across all UI surfaces  
Optimize rendering performance, bundle size, static assets, and client-side behavior  
Work with UX and product teams to validate feasibility of proposed designs and interactions  
Collaborate with backend and commerce teams to integrate data models, content, andpersonalization elements  
Maintain component libraries and adhere to naming, styling, and coding standards  
Conduct UI reviews, cross-browser checks, and regression validation for storefront releases. .

Job Details*

- We require someone who comes with a wide range of experience in the LAMP stack. Our software can be very complex, so be prepared. 

- We mainly use Javascript/jQuery for our frontend mainstay, so you would be required to gain proficiency in this as well. 

- We use a couple of database systems, MySQL and Apache Solr. You would be expected to become comfortable with their use, deployment, and scaling. 

- Our devs are mini-server admins as well and you would need to learn how to work through a Linux terminal. 

- We rigorously document our entire codebase, so you will be expected to document A LOT!

- We would prefer a candidate who can demonstrate creative live projects and has a Github profile they can show off. Although, this is not required.

 We're building automated customer service software and we need a full-stack developer to join our technological roller coaster. Join us and watch your product go through the entire life cycle. Plan it, build it, test it, deploy it, scale it, and sip coffee while you watch it grow!



 Currently open to Indian Applicants Only.

jobs_results.title: Senior Front-End Developer (Hyderabad)
jobs_results.description:
Project description  

We are looking for a skilled Front-End Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in React, modern JavaScript frameworks, responsive UI development, and integration with backend APIs in enterprise environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including backend engineers, architects, UX designers, DevOps engineers, and product owners to build scalable, high-performance applications using modern engineering practices and cloud technologies.  

Responsibilities

- Design and develop responsive, reusable, and maintainable web applications using React.
- Build modern user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
- Develop and maintain Micro Frontend (MFE) architectures for large-scale enterprise applications.
- Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs and backend microservices.
- Optimize application performance, accessibility, and overall user experience.
- Participate in application design, technical discussions, and architecture reviews.
- Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following industry best practices.
- Collaborate with QA teams to support automated and manual testing activities.
- Troubleshoot production issues and provide ongoing application support.
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and code reviews.

SKILLS  

Must have

- 10+ years of professional front-end development experience.
- Strong proficiency in React.js.
- Experience implementing Micro Frontends (MFE).
- Good knowledge of: o JavaScript (ES6+) o TypeScript o HTML5 o CSS3 / SCSS
- Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs.
- Familiarity with Git-based development workflows.
- Positive understanding of responsive and mobile-first design principles.
- Deep expertise in React ecosystem and component architecture.
- Strong understanding of front-end application performance optimization.
- Experience contributing to architecture and technical design decisions.
- Knowledge of CI/CD processes and deployment automation.
- Experience mentoring junior developers and conducting code reviews.
- Ability to lead development initiatives and drive technical improvements.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Nice to have  

- Experience with: o Redux, Zustand, or similar state management libraries o GraphQL o Node.js, Express.js, or NestJS o Next.js o Vue.js or Angular  Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker.  Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS and/or Azure.  Understanding of microservices-based architectures.  Experience working on banking, financial services, or other enterprise-scale systems.  Exposure to DevOps and cloud-native development practices. .
